content.short: Presearch is an open-source, decentralized search engine with a staking service for the PRE token, nodes, and a marketplace.
content.description: Presearch assembles a diverse set of tools into a cohesive platform, including a search engine, a staking service for the PRE token, decentralized nodes, and a marketplace. Users can earn token incentives when they use Presearch as their default search engine, turning everyday searches into a potential reward. For developers, running Presearch nodes helps improve the efficiency of the decentralized data service and reinforces the network's resilience against censorship.
